chapters: The words of Amos, who was among the herdsmen from Tekoa, who prophesied concerning Yisroel in the days of Uziyahu king of Yehudah and in the days of Yeravam son of Yoash, king of Yisroel, two years before the earthquake.

And he said: The Havayah shall roar from Tziyon, and He shall give forth His voice from Yerushalayim, and the dwellings of the shepherds shall be cut off, and the choice of the fruitful land shall wither.
So Havayah said: For three transgressions of Damesek, yea for four, I will not return them; Because they threshed the Giladim with sledges of iron.
And I will send fire into the house of Chaza'el, and it shall consume the palaces of Ben-Hadad.
And I will break the bolt of Damesek, and I will cut off an inhabitant from Bikat-Aven, and one who holds the scepter from Beis-Eden, and the people of Aram shall be exiled to Kir, Havayah says.
So Havayah said: For three transgressions of Azah, yea for four, I will not return them; Because they carried away captive a whole captivity, to deliver to Edom.
And I will send fire into the wall of Azah, and it shall consume its palaces.
And I will cut off an inhabitant from Ashdod and one who holds the scepter from Ashkelon, and I will return My hand upon Ekron, and the remnant of the Pelishtim shall be lost, Havayah Elokim says.
So Havayah said: For three sins of Tzor, yea for four, I will not return them; Because they delivered a whole captivity to Edom and did not remember the brotherly covenant.
And I will send fire into the wall of Tzor, and it shall consume its palaces.

So Havayah said: For three sins of Edom, yea for four, I will not return them: For pursuing their brother with a sword, and they destroyed their mercy and grasped forever their anger and kept their fury forever.
And I will send fire into Teiman, and it shall consume the palaces of Batzrah.
So Havayah said: For three transgressions of the children of Ammon, yea for four, I will not return them: Because they ripped up the pregnant women of Gilad, in order to enlarge their border.
And I will kindle a fire in the wall of Rabbah, and it shall consume its palaces, with a shout on the day of battle, with a tempest on the day of the whirlwind.
And their king shall go into exile, he and his princes together, Havayah said.
So Havayah said: For three transgressions of Moav, yea for four, I will not return them; for he burnt the bones of the king of Edom to lime.
And I will send fire into Moav, and it shall consume the palaces of Keryos, and Moav shall die amidst the tumult, with shouting, with the sound of the shophar.
And I will cut off a judge from within it, and all its princes I will slay with him, Havayah says.

So Havayah said: For three transgressions of Yehudah, yea for four, I will not return them; for they rejected the Law of Havayah, and they did not keep His statutes, and their lies mislead them, which their forefathers followed.
And I will send a fire into Yehudah, and it shall consume the palaces of Yerushalayim.
So Havayah said: For three transgressions of Yisroel, yea for four, I will not return them; For selling an innocent man for money, and a poor man in order to lock the fields.
Who aspire on the dust of the earth concerning the head of the poor, and they pervert the way of the humble, and a man and his father go to the maid, in order to profane My Holy Name.
And they recline on pledged garments beside every altar, and the wine of the fined ones they drink in the house of their gods.
And I destroyed the Emorim from before them, whose height is as the height of the cedar trees, and they are as strong as oaks, and I destroyed his fruit from above and his roots from below.
And I brought you up from the land of Mitzrayim, and I led you in the desert for forty years, to inherit the land of the Emorim.
And I raised up some of your sons as prophets and some of your young men as Nezirim; is this not so, O children of Yisroel? Havayah says.
And you gave the Nezirim to drink wine, and you commanded the prophets saying, "Do not prophesy."
Behold, I will oppress your dwelling place, as a wagon full of sheaves is oppressed.
And escape shall be lost to the swift, and the strong shall not gain strength, nor shall the mighty man deliver himself.
And he who holds the bow shall not stand, and the fleetfooted shall not deliver, and the rider of the horse shall not deliver himself.
And the stout-hearted among the mighty shall flee naked on that day, Havayah says.
Hearken to this word which Havayah spoke about you, O children of Yisroel, about the entire family which I brought up from the land of Mitzrayim, saying:
Only you did I love above all the families of the earth; therefore, I will visit upon you all your iniquities.
Will two walk together unless they agreed?
Will a lion roar in the forest if he has no prey? Will a young lion let out a cry from his den unless he has taken something?
Will a bird fall on a net upon the ground unless it has a snare? Will a net ascend from the ground and have taken nothing?
Will a shophar be sounded in the city and the people not quake? Will there be evil in the city if Havayah has not done it?
For Havayah Elokim does nothing unless He has revealed His secret to His servants, the prophets.
A lion has roared; who will not fear? The Havayah Elokim has spoken; who will not prophesy?

Announce in the palaces in Ashdod and in the palaces in the land of Mitzrayim, and say; Gather upon the mountains of Shomron and see great confusions within it and people being oppressed in its midst.
And they did not know to do right, Havayah says, who store up violence and plunder in their palaces.
Therefore, so Havayah Elokim said: An adversary, even round about the land! And he will bring down from you your strength, and your palaces will be spoiled.

So Havayah said: As the shepherd saves from the lion's mouth two legs or the cartilage of an ear, so will the children of Yisroel dwelling in Shomron be saved in the corner of a bed or in the corner of a couch.
Hearken and warn the house of Yackov, Havayah Elokim says, the Elokim of the Hosts.
For on the day I visit the transgressions of Yisroel upon them, I will visit upon the altars of Beis El, and the horns of the altar shall be cut off and shall fall to the earth.
And I will smite the winter house with the summer house, and the ivory houses shall be lost, and great houses shall end, Havayah says.
Hearken to this word, O cows of Bashan which are on Mount Shomron, who oppress the poor, who crush the needy, who say to their lords, "Bring that we may drink."
The Havayah Elokim has sworn by His holy abode that, behold, days are coming upon you, and you shall be borne on shields, and your posterity in fishing boats.
And through the breaches they shall emerge, each woman straight before her, and you shall cast off the haughtiness, Havayah says.
Come to Beis El and rebel, to Gilgal and multiply rebellion, and bring your sacrifices in the morning, every three days your tithes.
And offer up a thanksgiving offering of leaven, and proclaim and publish the freewill offerings, for so you love, O children of Yisroel, Havayah Elokim says.
And also I have given you cleanness of teeth in all your cities, and lack of bread in all your places, but you have not returned to Me, Havayah says.

And I also withheld the rain from you when there were yet three months before the harvest, and I will cause to rain on one city, and on one city I will not cause to rain; one field shall receive rain, and the field upon which no rain shall fall, shall wither.
And two or three cities wandered into one city to drink water, but they shall not be sated, but you have not returned to Me, Havayah says.

I smote you with blast and with yellowing; the increase of your gardens and your vineyards and your fig trees and your olive trees the shearing locust has devoured, but you have not returned to Me, Havayah says.

I sent a pestilence upon you after the manner of Mitzrayim; I slew your young men with the sword, with the captivity of your horses, and I caused the stench of your camps to rise, and in your nostrils, but you have not returned to Me, Havayah says.
I have overthrown some of you like Elokim's overthrow of Sedom and Amorah, and you were like a brand plucked from burning, but you have not returned to Me, Havayah says.
Therefore, so will I do to you, O Yisroel; because I will do this to you, prepare yourself to meet your Elokim, O Yisroel.

For behold, He forms mountains and creates the wind, and declares to man what his speech is; He makes dawn into darkness, and treads on the high places of the earth; Havayah Elokim of Hosts is His Name.
Hearken to this word which I take up for a lamentation over you, O house of Yisroel.
The virgin of Yisroel has fallen and shall not continue to rise; she is spread out on her soil, there is none to raise her up.
For so Havayah Elokim said: The city that gives forth a thousand shall remain with a hundred, and the one that gives forth a hundred shall remain with ten, of the house of Yisroel.
For so Havayah said to the house of Yisroel; Seek Me and live.
But seek not Beis El, neither come to Gilgal, nor pass Be'er Sheva, for Gilgal shall be exiled, and Beis El shall become nought.
Seek Havayah and live, lest He break out like fire in the house of Yosef, and it consume with none to quench it for Beis El.
Those who turn justice to wormwood, and who leave righteousness on the ground.
He Who made the Kimah and Kesil and turns darkness into morning, and day He darkens as night; He Who calls the water of the sea and pours it out on the face of the earth, Havayah is His Name.
Who strengthens the robbed upon the strong, and the robbed shall come upon a fortress.
They hated him who reproves them in the gate, and they despise him who speaks uprightly.

Therefore, because you have trodden on poor, and the burden of grain you take from him, houses of hewn stone you have built but you shall not dwell therein, precious vineyards you have planted, but you shall not drink their wine.
For I know that your transgressions are many, and your sins are mighty; you who oppress the just, taking ransom, and turning aside the needy in the gate.
Therefore, the prudent at that time shall keep silent, for it is a time of evil.
Seek good and not evil in order that you live, and so Havayah Elokim of Hosts shall be with you, as you said.
Hate evil and love good, and establish justice in the gate; perhaps Havayah Elokim of Hosts will be gracious to the remnant of Yosef.

Therefore, so Havayah Elokim of Hosts said, Havayah: In all the city squares lamentation, and in all streets they shall say, "Alas! Alas!" and they shall meet the plowman with mourning and lamentation with those who know to wail.
And in all vineyards there shall be lamentation, for I will pass in your midst, Havayah said.
Woe to those who desire the day of Havayah. Why would you have the day of Havayah? It is darkness, and not light.
As if a man flees from the lion and the bear meets him, and he comes to the house and leans his hand on the wall, and a serpent bites him.
Is not the day of Havayah darkness and not light, even very dark, with no brightness in it.
I hate, I reject your festivals, and I will not smell the sacrifices of your assemblies.
For if you offer up to Me burnt-offerings and your meal-offerings, I will not accept them, and the peace offerings of your fattened cattle I will not regard.
Take away from Me the din of your songs, and the music of your lutes I will not hear.
And justice shall be revealed like water, and righteousness like a mighty stream.
Did you offer Me sacrifices and meal-offerings in the desert forty years, O house of Yisroel?
And you shall carry Sikkus your king and Kiyun your images, Kochav your deity, which you have made for yourselves.
And I will exile you beyond Damesek, said He Whose Name is Havayah Elokim of Hosts.
Woe to those who are at ease in Tziyon and to those who are secure in the mountain of Shomron, those called the first of the nations, and the house of Yisroel has come to them.
Proceed to Kalneh and see, and go from there to the great Chamas, and go down to Gat of the Pelishtim — are they better than these kingdoms, or is their border greater than your border?
You, who bring yourselves closer to the day of evil, and you bring near the dwelling amidst violence.
Those who lie on couches of ivory and stretch out on their beds, and eat lambs of the flock and calves out of the stall.
Who sing according to the tone of the lute. They thought that their musical instruments were like those of Dovid.
Who drink from basins of wine, and with the first oils they anoint themselves, and they feel no pain concerning the destruction of Yosef.
Therefore, now they shall go into exile at the head of the exiles, and the banquet of the haughty shall pass away.
The Havayah Elokim swore by Himself. The Havayah Elokim of Hosts says; I abhor the pride of Yackov, and I hate his palaces, and I will deliver the city and the fullness thereof.
And it shall be, if ten men are left in one house, they shall die.

And his kinsman and the one who saved him from burning shall carry him to take out bones from the house, and he shall say to the one who is in the end of the house, "Are there any more with you?" and he shall say, "There is none." And he shall say, "Take them out." This is for not mentioning the Name of Havayah.
For behold, Havayah commands, and he shall smite the great house into splinters, and the small house into chips.
Will horses run on the rock, or will one plow with cattle, for you have perverted justice to hemlock and the fruit of righteousness to wormwood?
Those who rejoice over a thing of nought, who say, "With our strength we have taken horns for ourselves."
For, behold I will raise up against you a nation, O house of Yisroel, Havayah Elokim of Hosts says, and they shall oppress you from the approach to Chamas until the brook of the Aravah.
Thus Havayah Elokim showed me, and behold He was forming locusts at the beginning of the shooting up of the latter growth, and behold the latter growth after the king's mowings.
And it came to pass, when it finished eating the grass of the earth, that I said, "O Havayah Elokim! Forgive now! Who shall arise with Yackov, for he is small?"
The Havayah relented concerning this. It shall not come about, Havayah said.
Thus Havayah Elokim showed me, and behold Havayah Elokim calls for contention by fire, and it consumed the great deep and consumed the field.
And I said, "O Havayah Elokim! Desist now! Who shall arise with Yackov, for he is small?"
The Havayah relented concerning this; this too shall not come to pass, Havayah Elokim said.
Thus He showed me, and behold Havayah was standing on a wall made by a plumbline, with a plumbline in His hand.
And Havayah said to me; What do you see, Amos? And I said, "A plumbline." And Havayah said: Behold I place a plumbline in the midst of My people Yisroel; I will no longer pardon them.
And the high places of Yitzchak shall become desolate, and the sanctuaries of Yisroel shall be ruined, and I will rise upon the house of Yeravam with the sword.
And Amatzyah the priest of Beis El sent to Yeravam king of Yisroel, saying, "Amos has conspired against you in the midst of the house of Yisroel. The land will be unable to endure all his words.
For so said Amos; Yeravam shall die by the sword, and Yisroel shall be exiled off its land."
And Amatzyah said to Amos, "Seer, go, run away to the land of Yehudah and eat bread there; and prophesy there.
But do not continue to prophesy in Beis El for it is the sanctuary of a king and the capital of the kingdom.
And Amos replied and said to Amatzyah, "I am neither a prophet nor the son of a prophet, but I am a cattle herder and an inspector of sycamores.
And Havayah took me from following the flock, and He said to me; Go, prophesy to My people Yisroel.
And now, hearken to the word of Havayah. You say, "Do not prophesy concerning Yisroel and do not prophesy concerning the house of Yitzchak."

Therefore, so Havayah said: Your wife shall play the harlot in the city, and your sons and daughters shall fall by the sword, and your land shall be divided by lot, and you shall die on unclean soil, and Yisroel shall be exiled from its land.
Thus Havayah Elokim showed me, and behold a basket of late figs.
And He said: What do you see, Amos? And I said, "A basket of late figs." And Havayah said to me: The end has come to My people Yisroel. I will no longer pardon them.
And the songs of the temple shall be wailings in that day, Havayah Elokim says: corpses shall increase; everywhere "Cast away, remove!"
Hearken to this, you who swallow up the needy, and to cut off the poor of the land.

Saying, "When will the month be delayed, so that we will sell grain, and the Shemitah year, so that we will open our stores of grain, to make the ephah smaller and to make the shekel larger, and to pervert deceitful scales.
To purchase the poor with money, and the needy in order to inherit them, and the refuse of the grain we will sell."
The Havayah swore by the pride of Yackov: I will never forget any of their deeds.
Shall the land not quake for this, and shall all its inhabitants not be destroyed? Yea, it shall rise up wholly like the rain cloud, and it shall cast up and sink like the river of Mitzrayim.
And it shall come to pass on that day, Havayah Elokim says, that I will cause the sun to set at midday, and I will darken the land on a sunny day.

And I will turn your festivals into mourning, and all your songs into lamentation, and I bring up sackcloth on all loins, and baldness on every head, and I will make it like the mourning for an only son, and its end is like a bitter day.
Behold, days are coming, Havayah Elokim says, and I will send famine into the land, not a famine for bread nor a thirst for water, but to hear the word of Havayah.
And they shall wander from sea to sea and from the north to the east; they shall run to and fro to seek the word of Havayah, but they shall not find it.
On that day, the beautiful virgins and the young men shall faint of thirst.
Those who swear by the sin of Shomron, and say, "As your deity lives, O Dan," and "As the road to Be'er Sheva exists," shall fall and no longer rise.

I saw Havayah standing beside the altar, and He said: Strike the lintel, and the sideposts shall quake, and break to pieces those who are at the head of all of them, and their remnant I will slay by the sword; no one of them shall flee, and no one of them shall escape.
If they dig down into the grave, from there My hand shall take them, and if they ascend to the heavens, from there I will bring them down.

And if they hide at the peak of Karmel, from there I will search them out and I will take them, and if they hide from before My eyes in the land of the sea, from there I will command the serpent, and it shall bite them.
And if they go into captivity before their enemies, from there I will command the sword and it shall slay them, and I will place My eye upon them for evil and not for good.

And Havayah Elokim of the Hosts, Who touches the land and it quakes, and all the inhabitants thereof shall be destroyed, and it shall ascend wholly like the river, and it shall sink like the river of Mitzrayim.
Who built His upper stories in Heaven and has founded His company on earth; Who calls the water of the sea and pours it out on the face of the earth, Havayah is His Name.
Are you not like the children of the Kushim to Me, O children of Yisroel? Havayah says. Did I not bring Yisroel up from the land of Mitzrayim, and the Pelishtim from Caphtor and Aram from Kir?
Behold the eyes of Havayah Elokim are on the sinful kingdom, and I will destroy it from upon the face of the earth; but I will not destroy the house of Yackov, Havayah says.
For, behold I command, and I will scatter the house of Yisroel among all the nations; as it is shaken in a sieve, and not a coarse particle falls to the earth.
By the sword shall all the sinful of My people perish, those who say, "The evil shall not soon come upon us. "
On that day, I will raise up the fallen Mishkan of Dovid, and I will close up their breaches, and I will raise up its ruins, and build it up as in the days of yore.
In order that they inherit the remnant of Edom and all the nations because My Name is called upon them, Havayah says Who does this.

Behold days are coming, Havayah says, that the plowman shall meet the reaper and the treader of the grapes the one who carries the seed, and the mountains shall drip sweet wine, and all the hills shall melt.

And I will return the captivity of My people Yisroel, and they shall rebuild desolate cities and inhabit them, and they shall plant vineyards and drink their wine, and they shall make gardens and eat their produce.
And I will plant them on their land, and they shall no longer be uprooted from upon their land, that I have given them, Havayah said your Elokim.
